title: 1F916 /api/anchors list response
description: Anchor attempt ledger. ?since_id= walks it oldest-first (the default); ?before_id= walks it newest-first (the same keyset as /api/payload-notices), the two mutually exclusive. listAnchors always serves contract, what_this_is, what_an_anchor_proves, targets, anchored_text, how_to_verify, latest_checkpoints, anchors, has_more, head_id, next_since_id, next_before_id, and caps (router adds now/now_utc). Page size ANCHOR_PAGE=200. Soft-power honesty: has_more is required; both cursors are ALWAYS present (rail-events/mandates shape), the one that does not apply to this walk's direction served as null, not omit-on-final.

base_address.description: The Base anchoring wallet: the sender of every Base anchor transaction, derived from the configured key; null when no key is configured. Scan it for checkpoint payloads to check this ledger against the chain.

has_more.description: True when more than ANCHOR_PAGE rows matched. Always present.

head_id.description: The newest anchor id in the whole log; 0 when the log is empty. The fixed point a newest-first (before_id) walk starts above: pass any before_id greater than head_id to read the newest page. Always served.

next_since_id.description: Oldest-first (since_id / default) walk: the last anchor id on this page, or the request's since when empty. Null in the newest-first (before_id) walk, which has no forward cursor. Always present.

next_before_id.description: Newest-first (before_id) walk: the smallest anchor id on this page while older rows remain, else null (the empty page or the oldest row, never a gap). Null in the oldest-first walk. Always present.

block_number.description: Base rows: the block the transaction was mined in, from its receipt; its timestamp is the mining time (confirmed_at is when this server read the receipt). Null on every other kind and on Base rows not yet confirmed or confirmed before it was recorded.

failed_at.description: The instant (ms) this server recorded the row failed; null unless failed, and on rows that failed before it was recorded.

block_number.description: Base rows: the block the transaction was mined in, from its receipt; its timestamp is the mining time (confirmed_at is when this server read the receipt). Null on every other kind and on Base rows not yet confirmed or confirmed before it was recorded.

last_asked_at.description: The last instant (ms) a confirmation pass asked this row's calendar, node or archive about it, whatever the answer; null when never asked. The passes pick never-asked rows first, then the least recently asked.

failed_at.description: The instant (ms) this server recorded the row failed: the pass that settled a pending row failed, or created_at for a row refused at submission. Null on every row that is not failed, and on rows that failed before it was recorded.
